snippet.title: Double Dragon Revive | Tokyo Game Show 2025
snippet.description:
Double Dragon roars back to life in the modern era! Double Dragon Revive, coming Oct. 23, 2025
Available now for pre-order!

▼ Pre-order here:
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/double-dragon-revive-pre-order/9nggtkmk3qk6

The Double Dragon series has defined the belt-scroll action genre ever since it hit the arcades in 1987. Now it returns as Double Dragon Revive, thanks to the passionate support of retro game fans over the years!
